question: Among the already-triggered Top366 step216 states, do mechanically available animal/cash/feed/labor options plus frozen Wool-vs-Milk demand signals predict material Sheep expansion on an action-lineage held-out basis?
evidence_target: E2 lineage-held-out prediction only; never policy strength or causal option value
label: material Sheep expansion iff actual_cow_delta == 0 and actual_sheep_delta >= 1
independent_unit: h200 action lineage; episode rows are averaged within lineage before fitting

feature_semantics.free_pasture_slots: built PASTURE tiles without a placed animal at step216
feature_semantics.cash_after_two_sheep: public cash minus 1000, the engine cost of two Sheep
feature_semantics.feed_surplus_3d_after_two_sheep: private Wheat plus on-farm Wheat yield minus three days of feed for current placed animals plus two Sheep
feature_semantics.prior_worker_slack_rate_48: PASS or missing actor slots divided by public actor slots over steps168-215
feature_semantics.prior_mean_hands_48: mean public hired hands over steps168-215
feature_semantics.wool_minus_milk_residual_demand_72: known-shop/Town demand through step287 minus both farms' public held yield and gross scheduled animal base production, Wool minus Milk
feature_semantics.wool_minus_milk_price: public Wool price minus Milk price at step216
feature_semantics.wool_minus_milk_market_scarcity: Milk market inventory minus Wool inventory at step216; positive means Wool is scarcer

predictive_model.standardization: training lineages only in each fold
predictive_model.fit_unit: one mean feature vector and one pure binary label per action lineage

guardrails: No threshold or feature changes after reading the output.
The Top366 corpus remains Development and is not Fresh Holdout.
A pass supports prediction of Top-policy behavior, not that preserving options improves win probability.
Cow and Sheep component deltas remain separate; Cow removal is not inferred.
Requested market actions and replay state are Bronze evidence, not audited Gold counterfactuals.
